notes: Run of 2026-11-13. Six stories read. The two neighbourhood columns are declined: their headlines are about other businesses and would be false on any one building's page. The Frida window, The Marsh profile and the Tower Theatre photo essay name no address; the bail-bondsman story is a profile of a person.

findings.description: The Drawing Room plans to open a new space at the corner of 20th and Mission streets in January.

citation.label: Mission Local, “Mission Buzz: Radio Habana to open as a cafe during the day. Supes vote to rename Cesar Chavez St.,” 11 November 2026

raw.text: The Drawing Room will open a new space at the corner of 20th and Mission streets.

publish.note: A column whose headline is about Radio Habana and the Cesar Chavez Street renaming; carried on 2401 Mission it would describe something that did not happen there (the same call as the Revolution Cafe column, 19 August 2026). The column's other addresses (2868 Mission, a rummage sale; 1100 Valencia, Square's vacated storefront; 3083 16th Street, Lahore Karahi's closure) fail the same way.

resolution.method: EAS exact match on 2401 MISSION ST → parcel 3610029; sf-parcels has blklot 3610029 active, 3491–3491 20TH; the 2025 roll records it as commercial misc. EAS puts 2401, 2407, 2415, 2417 MISSION ST on that parcel, so per the directory contract the fact belongs on one page at the lowest, 2401.

publish.note: A neighbourhood roundup; its headline names three businesses at three addresses (726 Clement, 5351 Geary, and High Treason) and is true of none of them alone. 1815 Balboa Street is a book-club event venue.

resolution.method: EAS exact match on 5351 GEARY BLVD → parcel 1527036; sf-parcels has blklot 1527036 active, 5339–5351 GEARY; the 2025 roll records it as multi-family residential, built 1922.
